registered_at: 2026-11-05 before fitting any revised candidate or generating the fresh audit cohort
scope: Versioned experimental 48h model. Preserve original models/data/evaluations, 24h/72h behavior, stored risks and UI identity. No clinical claims.
development_source: Original seed2026 cohort TRAIN patients PG-0001..0072 and hours72..747 only; fit stride3. No original-test patient or audit patient in selection/training.
selection_rule: Highest mean validation AUPRC over three patient/time-disjoint, >=72h-purged folds; deterministic listed-order tie break. Raw margins only; no audit/test selection.
final_fit: Refit selected family once on original TRAIN72 patients/hours72..747, stride3; imputation/scaling fit on training only.
calibration: Original PG-0073..0084, hours849..1050, stride3. Positive-slope constrained Platt calibration on raw margins; L2 penalty0.5*(slope-1)^2 in summed log-loss.
threshold_selection: Original PG-0085..0096, hours849..1050, stride3. Max F1 among cutoffs with >0 TP and FPR<=0.10; highest threshold tie-break. Unvalidated demonstration operating point, never clinical.

fresh_audit.eligible: Original eligibility; >=72h baseline, no active episode; full original 72h follow-up. All eligible hourly audit rows in the specified window.
fresh_audit.environment: The same protected historical city-grid cache; not new weather/station data. Independent synthetic patients/outcomes only.

audit_lock: Generate/evaluate fresh audit cohort only after candidate, fitted pipeline, calibration and threshold have been saved and hashed. One audit, no seed/feature/hyperparameter retries based on its outcomes.
experimental_availability_gate: On fresh audit: revised AUPRC >=1.10*original48 AUPRC; revised AUROC>=original48 AUROC; revised Brier<=original48 Brier+0.0001; validation-selected threshold recall>0 and FPR<=0.15. No claim of statistical/clinical superiority merely from point estimates.
uncertainty: 300 paired patient-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed20261106; 95% intervals and metric differences reported. Known original held-out test is a secondary historical benchmark only.
integration: Separate versioned revised48 inference/comparison panel; original saved 24/48/72h risks/history, explanations, scenarios and alerts remain v1 and explicitly labelled. New patient inference still unsupported. No live environment/manual/device data enter either pipeline.
